blocks.text: Glitch, Step Sequencer, and Oscillator Bank now work immediately on open — audio context is now guaranteed ready before any app factory runs.
Step Sequencer now falls back to the Poly Synth when Wavetable Synth is not open, so it works standalone.
App content is no longer clipped — removed overflow restriction that was cutting controls at the edge of windows.
Peak meter no longer shows a dark rectangle when the signal is silent — the bar only appears when audio is playing.
Removed redundant app name labels from inside every app — the titlebar already shows the name.
Peak meters in titlebars, wire colors by signal type, workspace right-click menu, lock workspace.
